summary: Frontend-only responsive header QA after the mobile two-row restructure (flex-col sm:flex-row). Tested 5 viewports (320, 390, 414, 768, 1440), search dropdown for MSFT/Tesla/International, and regressions (Explore popover, Condense toggle, Menu/Theme/aurora, Categories absent from sidebar, click-result closes dropdown). All 14 acceptance criteria pass. Zero horizontal overflow at every viewport — scrollWidth == innerWidth in every case. No bugs found.

design_issues.screen: Header at exactly sm breakpoint (~768px tablet portrait)
issues: Search input collapses to only ~70px wide (x=214, w=70, right=283) because Explore/Portfolio/Condense/Menu buttons render with full text labels (121+~55+140+106 = ~422px) on the same row. Not a regression introduced by this fix, but the input is uncomfortably narrow for tablet portrait. Consider keeping icon-only buttons until md: (>=1024) or making the search bar a fixed min-width.

action_items: Optional polish: at tablet portrait (768px), reduce action-button label verbosity (icon-only until md:) so the search input gets adequate width. Search is currently 70px wide at 768. Not blocking — pure UX improvement.
critical_code_review_comments: Header restructure is correct: outer `flex flex-col sm:flex-row` + inner `flex-1 min-w-0 max-w-2xl` on search container gives the search bar a full-width row on mobile and proper flex-grow on desktop. min-w-0 on the search wrapper is critical and present — without it the input would push beyond 100%.

Dropdown uses `absolute top-full mt-2 left-0 right-0 z-[55] max-h-[55vh] overflow-y-auto` which is the correct pattern for a viewport-bounded dropdown anchored to its relatively-positioned parent. Verified: right edge stays at parent's right (378 of 390 vpW) at every tested width.

Action-button row `flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2 flex-shrink-0 sm:ml-auto justify-end` correctly right-aligns on both mobile (row 2) and desktop (end of row 1). flex-shrink-0 prevents buttons from squishing.
Buttons use `flex-col sm:flex-row h-12 sm:h-11` so mobile shows stacked icon+label in a 12-unit tall pill and desktop shows inline — good responsive pattern.
App.js is now ~1500+ lines (HomePage alone) — still warrants splitting (flagged in prior iterations). The header JSX block at L1133-1351 is a good extraction candidate as a <HeaderBar /> component.
MSFT dropdown showed only 3 results (MSFT, MSFU, MSFW) — backend search returned correctly; no truncation.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only UI tests. Aurora background was set in localStorage during regression test; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header is `flex-col sm:flex-row` at App.js L1137. Search dropdown at L1184 uses left-0 right-0 max-h-[55vh]. Verified measurements at 390x844: search input width=334 (vs ~80 pre-fix), dropdown right edge=378/390, all 4 row-2 buttons (Explore x=158/w=50, Portfolio x=212/w=54, Condense x=270/w=62, Menu x=336/w=42) fit cleanly. At 320x568 still fits (Menu right=308/320). Only design nit: at exact sm-breakpoint 768px tablet, the search shrinks to 70px because button text labels are full-width on row 1; consider icon-only until md:.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — feature verified, no bug found. Original mobile overflow bug (search showed 'Search s...' at ~80px) is fully fixed: search is now 334px on iPhone 14 viewport with no horizontal page overflow.
